## Goal

Set up the `packages/site` package properly with all dependencies, configuration, navigation data, and TypeScript aliases.

## Steps

### 1. Update packages/site/package.json

Change the package name to `chassis-react-site` and add all required dependencies. Examine `chassis-figma/site/package.json` for the full dep list. Key additions:

**dependencies to add/update:**
- `@chassis-ui/docs`: `"link:../../../chassis-website/packages/docs"`
- `@chassis-ui/icons`: `"link:../../../chassis-icons"`
- Keep `@chassis-ui/react: workspace:*`
- Keep `@chassis-ui/css: link:../../../chassis-css`
- Keep `@chassis-ui/tokens: link:../../../chassis-tokens`

**devDependencies to add:**
- `@astrojs/prism` — for prism syntax highlighting
- `@astrojs/markdown-remark` — for rehypeHeadingIds
- `@docsearch/css` and `@docsearch/js` — Algolia DocSearch
- `astro-auto-import` — shortcode auto-import
- `autoprefixer`, `postcss` — PostCSS processing
- `js-yaml`, `@types/js-yaml` — config.yml parsing
- `rehype-autolink-headings` — heading anchor links
- `github-slugger` — slug generation for sidebar
- `mdast-util-from-markdown`, `mdast-util-mdx-jsx`, `mdast-util-to-string` — MDX utilities
- `remark`, `remark-html` — markdown processing in libs
- `unified` — remark/rehype plugin system
- `zod` — config validation
- `picocolors` — for any CLI output in libs
- `clipboard` — copy-to-clipboard in code blocks (check if @chassis-ui/docs needs it)
- `prismjs`, `@types/prismjs` — syntax highlighting

Remove devDependencies that are replaced:
- `unist-util-visit` (now comes from @chassis-ui/docs)

Keep:
- `@astrojs/mdx`, `@astrojs/react`, `@astrojs/sitemap`, `@astrojs/check`
- `@types/react`, `@types/react-dom`, `@types/hast`
- `react`, `react-dom`
- `sass`
- `typescript`

### 2. Create packages/site/config.yml

Use `codebase-facts.md` for the complete config values. Key points:
- `title: "Chassis React"`
- `baseURL: "https://chassis-ui.com/react"`
- `docsDir: "."` (cwd at build time is packages/site/)
- `docsPath: "/react/docs"`
- `subtitle: "React UI Component Library for Chassis Design System"`
- `description: "Build accessible, responsive React interfaces with Chassis UI's component library. Powered by TypeScript, Chassis CSS, and design tokens."`
- Same `analytics`, `algolia`, `anchors`, `toc`, `blog` values as other sites

### 3. Create packages/site/data/sidebar.yml

Build the full sidebar from the 43 MDX files in `packages/site/content/`. The structure must match what `DocsSidebar.astro` from `@chassis-ui/docs` expects.

**How DocsSidebar generates URLs**: `{docsPath}/{groupSlug}/{pageSlug}` where slugs are generated by `github-slugger` from the title string. So title `"Getting Started"` → slug `getting-started`, title `"Navs & Tabs"` → slug `navs-tabs`.

The URL for a page is built as: `{docsPath}/{groupSlug}/{pageSlug}`. For top-level components (no folder prefix in content), the group slug IS the top-level group, and page slug is the component name.

IMPORTANT: Verify that the slugs generated from titles match the actual MDX file paths. Examine the content directory structure: `packages/site/content/`. Components at root level have IDs like `button`, `modal`. Forms are at `forms/overview`, `forms/select`, etc.

For single-level docs (components not in subfolders), the sidebar entry is at the top-level group. For `forms/*` docs, they are in a `Forms` group. For `layout/*`, they are in a `Layout` group. For `patterns/*`, they are in a `Patterns` group.

Full sections to include:
- **Getting Started**: Introduction
- **Layout**: Breakpoints, Containers, Grid, Columns, Gutters  
- **Components**: Accordion, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Button Group, Card, Carousel, Close Button, Collapse, Dropdown, Image, List Group, Modal, Navbar, Navs & Tabs, Notification, Offcanvas, Pagination, Placeholder, Popover, Progress, Spinner, Table, Toast, Tooltip
- **Forms**: Overview, Form Control, Select, Checks & Radios, Range, Input Group, Floating Labels, Layout, Validation
- **Patterns**: Dashboard Widgets, Form Processing, Paginated Table

### 4. Update packages/site/tsconfig.json

Add path aliases matching `chassis-figma/site/tsconfig.json` pattern:
```json
{
  "extends": "astro/tsconfigs/strict",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "ignoreDeprecations": "6.0",
    "baseUrl": ".",
    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "paths": {
      "@css/*": ["../../node_modules/@chassis-ui/css/dist/*"],
      "@icons/*": ["../../node_modules/@chassis-ui/icons/*"],
      "@assets/*": ["src/assets/*"],
      "@components/*": ["src/components/*"],
      "@layouts/*": ["src/layouts/*"],
      "@libs/*": ["src/libs/*"],
      "@scss/*": ["src/scss/*"],
      "@shortcodes/*": ["src/components/shortcodes/*"]
    }
  }
}
```

Note: `@css/*` and `@icons/*` paths are at `../../node_modules/` because cwd is `packages/site/` and node_modules for these linked packages resolve at the repo root.

### 5. Create packages/site/postcss.config.ts

```ts
import autoprefixer from 'autoprefixer'
export default { plugins: [autoprefixer] }
```

### 6. Run pnpm install

After all package.json changes:
```bash
cd /Volumes/Ozgur/Dropbox/Sites/chassis-react && pnpm install
```

Verify `@chassis-ui/docs`, `@chassis-ui/icons` are resolved in `packages/site/node_modules/`.

## Verification

- `pnpm install` completes without errors
- `packages/site/node_modules/@chassis-ui/docs/` exists and is symlinked to chassis-website/packages/docs
- `packages/site/config.yml` validates against the config schema
- `packages/site/data/sidebar.yml` lists all 43 content pages
